diagram.alt: Graph drawn on x and f prime(x) axes; 1 plotted line, curve or set of points is drawn. Marked on the horizontal axis: minus 2, 2; vertical axis: minus 4. Read the question for what it asks.

manual.title: Extreme values of sine plus cosine
manual.prompt: Find the maximum and minimum values of $y=\sin x+\cos x$ for $0\le x\le2\pi$ using calculus.

manual.title: Inflection of x minus one times e to the x
manual.prompt: Show that $y=(x-1)e^{x}$ has $y'=xe^{x}$, and find its point of inflection.

manual.title: Open box with a square base and least material
manual.prompt: An open-top box with a square base must hold $32\,000$ cm$^{3}$. Find the dimensions that use the least material.

manual.title: Stationary points from x times x minus three squared
manual.prompt: A function has $f'(x)=x(x-3)^{2}$. Find the $x$-values of its stationary points and their nature, and the interval where $f$ is decreasing.

manual.title: Closest approach of two ships
manual.prompt: Ship $A$ is $10$ km due north of ship $B$. $A$ sails south at $4$ km/h and $B$ sails east at $3$ km/h. Find the minimum distance between them and when it occurs.

diagram.alt: Diagram. Labels shown: A, B, 4t, 3t. Read the question for what it asks.

manual.title: Cubic from two given stationary points
manual.prompt: The cubic $y=ax^{3}+bx^{2}+cx+d$ has stationary points at $(0,4)$ and $(2,0)$. Find $a$, $b$, $c$ and $d$.

diagram.alt: Graph drawn on x and y axes; 1 plotted line, curve or set of points is drawn. Read the question for what it asks.

manual.title: Cheapest speed for a five hundred kilometre trip
manual.prompt: A truck travels $500$ km at a constant $v$ km/h. Running costs are $16+\dfrac{v^{2}}{100}$ dollars per hour. Find the speed that minimises the total cost, and that cost.

manual.title: Poster with unequal margins
manual.prompt: A poster has a printed area of $384$ cm$^{2}$, with margins of $3$ cm at the top and bottom and $2$ cm at each side. Find the dimensions of the poster with least total area.

diagram.alt: Diagram. Labels include: 3, 2. Read the question for what it asks.

manual.title: Inflection of e to the x minus x squared at log two
manual.prompt: Show that $y=e^{x}-x^{2}$ has a point of inflection at $x=\ln2$ and find its $y$-coordinate.

manual.title: Isosceles triangle of perimeter thirty with greatest area
manual.prompt: An isosceles triangle has perimeter $30$ cm and base $2x$ cm. Show that its area is $A=x\sqrt{225-30x}$ and find the maximum area.

manual.title: Sine plus half x on one period
manual.prompt: For $y=\sin x+\tfrac x2$, $0\le x\le2\pi$, find the stationary points and the point of inflection.

diagram.alt: Graph drawn on x and y axes; 1 plotted line, curve or set of points is drawn. Labels include: pi. Read the question for what it asks.

manual.title: Information from a straight line derivative graph
manual.prompt: The graph of $y=f'(x)=2-x$ is shown. Find where $f$ has a stationary point and its nature, and describe the concavity of $y=f(x)$.

diagram.alt: Graph drawn on x and f prime(x) axes; 1 plotted line, curve or set of points is drawn. Marked on the horizontal axis: 2; vertical axis: 2. Read the question for what it asks.

manual.title: Tunnel entrance with a semicircular top
manual.prompt: A tunnel entrance is a rectangle of width $2r$ topped by a semicircle. Its total perimeter (including the base) is $8$ m. Show that its area is $A=8r-\left(2+\tfrac\pi2\right)r^{2}$ and find the maximum area to two decimal places.

diagram.alt: Diagram. Labels shown: r, h. Read the question for what it asks.

manual.title: Three inflection points of a quintic
manual.prompt: Find the $x$-coordinates of the points of inflection of $y=3x^{5}-5x^{3}$, and the exact $y$-coordinate at the positive one.

manual.title: Plot with a dearer front fence
manual.prompt: A rectangular plot of $800$ m$^{2}$ needs fencing. The front costs $\$30$ per metre and the other three sides $\$10$ per metre. Find the dimensions giving least cost, and that cost.
hints: Front and back both have length x.

ladder.nudge: Front and back both have length x.

manual.title: Shape of f from f prime equal to e to the x minus two
manual.prompt: A function has $f'(x)=e^{x}-2$. Find the $x$-value and nature of its stationary point, and describe its concavity.
